notes.title: Bugfix
notes.notes:
Today I managed to find and fix a bug that some players complained about.

The animation control joystick was hiding off the screen and players would get stuck on the animation.

The bug has been fixed, the joystick now measures your screen with a tape measure, and goes to it.
